name: app-lime-flight-results-phone-tilted-on-fabric
title: Lime Flight Results Phone on Fabric
whatItIs: A lime-bezel phone balanced on a diagonal ledge of lime fabric, showing a flight results screen with a dark green summary card, price date chips, a flight card and a lime premium promo.
whatItMeans: A monochrome lime world with dark green anchors feels fresh and energetic. The balancing pose adds tension.
techniques: Phone balancing on a corner for drama
Tonal scene from bezel to background
Selected date chip in lime, others neutral
Dark green header card for contrast
Toggle and premium banner as secondary accents

vocabulary.definition: A device propped on an edge for a dynamic angle.
A highlighted option among a row of choices.
A device frame coloured to match the scene.
